[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Torn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he plotted to kill [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Vader survived an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] flushing and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE]] attack with the help of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Vader destroyed the bridge windows, forcing Torn to don a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]]. Vader forced him to open a channel to Fett at the command chair, and then [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] snapped his neck, saying he could have the post.<ref name="ADV" />

Vader reflected that his willingness to sacrifice a squad of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] was indicative of a fearful man.<ref name="ADV" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Torn appears in the short comic [[The Assassination of Darth Vader|''Star Wars: The Assassination of Darth Vader'']], released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] as part of [[Free Comic Book Day]] [[2013]].<ref name="ADV" />

Despite appearing in a recent work, Torn's [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia]] does not correspond<ref name="ADV" /> to the system established in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> While his rank plaque does bear six squares, four of them are red and only two are blue.<ref name="ADV" /> The rank guide appearing in ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' showed that an officer with the position of Captain displayed their rank with three red squares placed on top of three blue squares.<ref name="EGW" /> Other officers appearing in ''The Assassination of Darth Vader'' also bore non-standard rank insignia.<ref name="ADV" />
